draft: Rain drummed on the window. The dog hid behind the sofa and whined softly until the owner sat nearby, and then its curled tail thumped once, twice, against the floor.

memories.text: On a rainy day with thunder, the dog hides behind the sofa and whines softly until the owner sits nearby; when the rain eases it goes to the window to watch the rain.
The dog seemed to watch the rain from the window for a long time this morning â unconfirmed, single observation.
The dog's name in stories is the twin's name only; the owner is 'the owner'. No other people are named in stories unless a shared memory names them.
The dog is afraid of thunder. When thunder sounds it hides behind the sofa and whines softly until the owner sits nearby.
The dog's favourite walk is the small park two streets from home, in the morning.
